name: Hidden hatch
notes: The outer end of the Hollow Tree service tunnel. It is a mundane concealed hatch enhanced by Fey workmanship, not a Fairy Door. During Down the Rabbit-Hole it provides a narrow escape that leaves the patrol aware that someone slipped away and searching the surrounding woods. Coinín can open it quickly from inside.
atmosphere: Wet leaves, disturbed earth, and a thin draught escaping through an invisible seam.
description: A disguised hatch among mossy stones and roots near the far side of the Fairy Ring glade. From above it is almost indistinguishable from the forest floor.
